'''Korventine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] within the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war she was stationed in the Republic's secret [[Belsavis prison|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. In the prison she operated a stall in the [[Prison Command Center]] of the [[Minimum Security Section]], where she sold equipment from a stall to various Republic personnel. She wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with [[Color/Legends|orange]] coloring and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] while at his stall. Lorchlar had brown skin, black hair, and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Korventine appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Equipment Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Belsavis.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Korventine was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
